title: 回到舒服站姿
description: 成人低墙从侧身回到正对墙的稳定双脚站姿。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult settles back into a neutral stance on a low wall after a small side turn, both feet on broad footholds and both hands resting on comfortable jugs. The pelvis levels and shoulders face the wall naturally, with a calm head position. Capture the restful reset rather than a difficult move. A wide horizontal view includes a blank bench outside the landing area, continuous mat, and an easy immediate step-down route. Use quilted textile illustration with stitched fabric shapes, readable adult anatomy, felt-like mat surfaces, and a calm blue and sand palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
